addresses.name: country
addresses.note: Built from two upstream sources joined by scripts/gr/ in this repo: Hellenic Cadastre declared-streets points (street name + number only, no city) and the Ministry of Environment & Energy's national Kallikratis municipality boundaries, used to attach a city name via spatial join. See scripts/gr/README.md.
